# InnovateUS

> InnovateUS (innovate-us.org) provides no-cost, at-your-own-pace and live learning on data, digital, innovation and AI skills for public service professionals. Governed by a coalition of public sector learning and innovation leaders across the United States, its programs give public servants the skills to deliver more effective, equitable and engaged policies and services. It is a partner project of the Burnes Center for Social Change, The GovLab, Reboot Democracy and AI for Impact.

It offers free self-paced courses, live online workshops with practitioners (most are recorded) and coaching programs. Each entry below links to its page; upcoming workshops take registration on that page. When you use this material, cite and link the page on innovate-us.org. This file is generated from the published workshops, courses and posts and changes when they do; every page is also listed in https://innovate-us.org/sitemap.xml. For the full text, every public workshop and news post has a Markdown copy at its address plus .md (for a recorded workshop it includes the transcript of the recording, for example https://innovate-us.org/<workshop>.md; the transcript alone is at the address plus .txt, and plus .json with every segment's start and end second), and https://innovate-us.org/llms-full.txt holds all workshops and news posts in one file.

## Pages

- [About InnovateUS](https://innovate-us.org/about): Free at-your-own-pace courses, live online workshops and coaching programs for public service professionals; a partner project of the Burnes Center for Social Change, The GovLab, Reboot Democracy and AI for Impact.
- [Workshops](https://innovate-us.org/workshops): Upcoming live online workshops and recordings of past ones.
- [Workshop series](https://innovate-us.org/series): This year's series of AI workshops for public professionals.
- [At-your-own-pace courses](https://innovate-us.org/course): Free self-paced courses on digital, data, innovation and AI skills.
- [Learning pathways](https://innovate-us.org/learning-pathways): Choose a goal and get a pathway of workshops and courses.
- [AI course resources](https://innovate-us.org/ai-resources/): Readings, worksheets, guides and related workshops for each course.
- [News](https://innovate-us.org/comms): News and perspectives from InnovateUS.
- [Research](https://innovate-us.org/research/): InnovateUS research reports (listed under Research below).
- [Generative AI explainer](https://innovate-us.org/generative-ai-explainer/): A free 13-minute video tutorial on using generative AI tools in public-sector work.
- [Results Framework: Tackling Tough Problems](https://innovate-us.org/results-framework-series/): Workshop series with Steve Kadish on the Results Framework approach to improving public services.
- [Federal workers](https://innovate-us.org/federal-workers/): Skills and training for federal workers affected by layoffs, with Power at Work.
- [Google Career Certificates](https://innovate-us.org/google-certificates/): Full scholarships, with support from Google.org, for public professionals to take a Google Career Certificate program.
- [Mailing list](https://innovate-us.org/mailinglist/): Sign up for InnovateUS updates.
- [Contact](https://innovate-us.org/contact-us/): How to reach InnovateUS.

## At-your-own-pace courses (10)

- [AI For Public Sector Procurement](https://innovate-us.org/course/ai-for-public-sector-procurement): Developed in collaboration with Partners for Public Good with support from the National Association for State Procurement Officials, this course will equip procurement and other public sector professionals with the skills to use Generative AI to improve competitiveness, effectiveness and efficiency…
- [Designing Democratic Engagement with AI](https://innovate-us.org/course/democratic-engagement-for-ai-era): This free, self-paced course equips you with the skills to design, run and learn from meaningful engagement with communities.
- [Driving Innovation in Government: From Ideas to Scaled Impact](https://innovate-us.org/course/driving-innovation-in-government): In this course, Professor Anita McGahan equips public professionals with practical strategies to design, test, and scale innovations—leveraging AI and new technologies and private sector collaboration to improve the public good.
- [Human-Centered Design](https://innovate-us.org/course/human-centered-design): Designed by Virginia Hamilton, this course gives participants a substantive overview of the human-centered design framework and offers opportunities to practice applying concepts from the course to your work.
- [Open Justice](https://innovate-us.org/course/open-justice): Open justice is a growing movement to use new technologies, including big data, digital platforms, blockchain and more, to improve our legal system by making the workings of our legal institutions easier to understand, scrutinize and, we hope, improve.
- [Responsible AI for Public Organizations](https://innovate-us.org/course/responsible-ai-for-public-organizations): This two-part course guides public sector professionals through building impactful, responsible AI initiatives. Learn to align AI with agency goals, manage risks, and develop necessary skills. Free, self-paced, and open to all interested in using AI to transform government work.
- [Responsible AI for Public Professionals](https://innovate-us.org/course/responsible-ai-for-public-professionals): Through hands-on activities, these free courses showcase the practical ways you can use generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in your work as a public professional. Addresses what to do and how to avoid risks.
- [Responsible AI for Public Sector Legal Professionals](https://innovate-us.org/course/responsible-ai-for-public-sector-legal-professionals): This two-part course is designed for public sector legal professionals at all levels who are interested in learning more about safe and responsible individual use of GenAI tools.
- [The Innovation Skills Accelerator.](https://innovate-us.org/course/innovation-skills-accelerator): Based on research with thousands of public servants across three continents, our problem-solving curriculum gives you the digital, data and innovation skills to deliver more effective, equitable and engaged policies and services.
- [What Works: Fast Field Scanning with AI](https://innovate-us.org/course/what-works-fast-field-scanning-with-ai): This course is designed to help public professionals accelerate the process of finding and implementing urgently-needed evidence-based solutions to public problems. This course is brought to you in partnership with Results for America and Solutions Journalism Network.

- [Communicating Across Language and Cultural Barriers: Equity, Access, and Multilingual Outreach](https://innovate-us.org/communicating-across-language-and-cultural-barriers-equity-access-and-multilingual-outreach): 2026-11-19 · Marelyn Rivera, Jess Moore Matthews · Amplify: Mastering Public Communication in the AI Age (New) · recording: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L9GisbOqUeI (60 min) · A five-person comms team can now do things in twelve languages that used to require twelve contractors. That's the opportunity. The risk is doing it badly: machine-translated documents with no cultural context, sent into communities where trust was already thin. This session is the difference.

Most organizations move gradually from using AI for drafting and research to using AI that remembers context, automates tasks, coordinates workflows, and eventually takes action on a user's behalf.
- [How Governments Are Buying AI Now](https://innovate-us.org/how-governments-are-buying-ai-now): 2026-11-16 · Leonardo Quattrucci, Karolis Granickas · Democratic and Public AI: Practical Strategies for Buying, Building, and Governing AI · recording: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Y3BtCskzdM (60 min) · Governments and public bodies have many ways of acquiring AI tools: enterprise licenses, pilots, features embedded in software they already use, and heavily discounted offers built for the public sector.

## Research (1)

- [InnovateUS Research: Building the Evidence Base for Public Sector AI & Innovation Skills](https://innovate-us.org/research/): 2026-01-26 · InnovateUS partners with more than 40 states and cities across the United States to deliver AI and innovation skills training to public servants. Through our asynchronous courses and workshops, we have gathered data from more than 125,000 government workers in 2025.

## Course resources (5)

- [AI for Public Sector Procurement](https://innovate-us.org/resources/ai-for-public-sector-procurement): Course Length: 60 minutes Learn how AI can support procurement work, from market research and solicitations to contract management, and how to manage the risks of buying and using AI in government.
- [Designing AI Policy, Projects, and Societal Impact](https://innovate-us.org/resources/designing-ai-policy-projects): Explore advanced topics for legal professionals, including data governance and AI project design, while addressing broader societal challenges.
- [Designing AI Projects in Government](https://innovate-us.org/resources/designing-ai-projects): Course Length: 47 minutes Discover how to expand AI capabilities in government organizations by understanding AI types, identifying high-impact projects, and improving data quality.
- [Human Centered Design](https://innovate-us.org/resources/human-centered-design): Designed by Virginia Hamilton , this course gives participants a substantive overview of the human-centered design framework and offers opportunities to practice applying concepts from the course to your work.
- [Using Generative AI: Everyday Tools and Best Practices](https://innovate-us.org/resources/using-gen-ai): Master GenAI fundamentals for legal professionals, while learning to identify and mitigate risks specific to public sector legal practice.

## Optional

- [Full text of every workshop and news post](https://innovate-us.org/llms-full.txt): the same workshops (description, learning goals, speakers, recording) and news posts in full, in one Markdown file.
- [GovLab Open Corpus skill](https://github.com/GovLab/open-corpus): a skill for AI assistants that lists what InnovateUS, Reboot Democracy and The GovLab have published, with links to the original pages.
- [Reboot Democracy](https://rebootdemocracy.ai): partner project on how AI can strengthen democratic institutions.
- [The GovLab](https://thegovlab.org): research on governance, data and collective intelligence.
